merge.why: User ruling: keep these thirteen non-Purphoros Gods together for mulligan decisions even if automatic discovery separates them. Each is a one-of Replenish payload, and the opening hand usually wants to discard it. Their exact identities can matter after the graveyard is stocked, but this table uses their payload count.

Provisional K=17 trial requested for the first feasible exhaustive mulligan table. Both are unique Purphoros payoffs; one grants haste and the other deals entry damage, so compare this merge against a K=18 split before final adoption.
